_comment: Review of every tray setting row (check, choice and toggle) for help text (WCAG 3.3.5). A tray row has no help line of its own: « self_explained » rows say their effect in their label, « needs_help » rows do not, and the reason says what a help text must add. tools/test/test-menu-settings-help-review.cjs requires one entry per setting row of _shared/menu/data/menu.toml. Reviewed by the agent on 2026-11-25.
